QuantRule shell
INPUT > DATA > MODEL > OUTPUT; the shell wraps the pipeline.

Data
  candles <csv-path>              Read strictly; last 1000 candles as NDJSON.
  candles-tolerant <csv-path>     Skip bad rows; NDJSON plus quality on stderr.
  timeframes <csv-path>           Build M1/M5/M15/H1; NDJSON plus aggregation.
Model
  market-state <csv-path>         Four-timeframe state as JSON.
  market-dashboard <csv-path>     Four-axis dashboard, one row per timeframe.
  market-chart <csv-path>         Deterministic PNG of candles and axes.
  market-report <csv-path>        Full-period report: four artifacts.
  axis <csv-path> <axis>          One axis per timeframe.
  events <csv-path>               Every event in the analyzed window.
  legs <csv-path>                 Minor and major leg per timeframe.
  model-series <csv-path>         Last complete model bars.
Research
  research export <csv-path> <dataset> Research dataset with layers and metadata.
  research summary <csv-path>     Counts, ranges, histograms, relations.
Strategy
  strategy-run <csv-path>         Entries and exits; no fills or P&L.
  strategy explain --config <run> Render the strategy in trader words.
Runs
  report <engine> --config <run>  One config-driven report bundle.
  backtest --config <run>         Five bundles from one full run.
  lab summary <lab-dir>           Root summary.txt for a lab result folder.
  policy check --config <run>     Validate the policy and engine configs.
Store
  store init [--db <path>]        Create or open the SQLite store.
  store ingest <csv-path>         Ingest one M1 dataset.
  store verify <csv-path>         Compare a dataset with a fresh build.
  store list [--db <path>]        List stored datasets as CSV.
  store show <dataset> <table>    Show one stored table.
  store remove <dataset>          Remove one dataset and its rows.
  db series <dataset>             Stored candles as NDJSON.
  db bars <dataset>               Full stored bar rows as CSV.
  db metrics <dataset>            Metrics and resolutions as CSV.
  db layer3 <dataset>             Materialized Layer 3 rows as CSV.
Sources
  fetch <symbol> <start> <end>    Fetch BID candles; CSV and optional PNG.
Shell
  help [topic]                    This map, a command, or a reference topic.
  quit                            Exit the shell.

Reference  help <command> | help all | help glossary | help tutorial | help roles
